hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that replaces Uniswap v4 pool mechanics with a concentrated bonding curve backed by Euler vault positions. In beforeSwap, it handles the full swap: takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta. Liquidity addition and donations are blocked via intentional reverts.
